column1: # Design/NativeCoverage.tsv: instructions of ported routines, and of what they call or run into, that no comparison
# covers (ADR-010 item 5), each with the reason. For a routine that always waits that is an instruction no interpreted
# run reaches whose digests a native run reproduces; for any other, one no compared call runs. What the replays and
# the constructed tests in GameLogicTests run is measured from their native reports and offsets files, and is not
# listed here. Tools/RoutineCoverage.py reads this file, and CI runs it; it fails on an instruction left unexplained,
# and on one listed here that the runs now cover.
